newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics rise on fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics rise on fundamentals.

text.p: Major electronic shares rose sharply at mid-session on Friday as their sound fundamentals continued to attract strong buying, brokers said.
With 40 minutes left, United Microelectronics rose T$1.50 to T$42.20, Mosel was up T$2.60 to T$44.50 and Acer Inc gained T$1.50 to T$63.

Electronics have been one of Taiwan's most profitable sectors for several years. The island's leading computer and semiconductor companies are widely expected to continue thriving in a prosperous global industry.

"Large electronic shares are blue-chips that always draw buying for institutions and foreign funds, especially during a bullish period like now," said Oliver Fang, senior analyst for National Securities.
The overall index was up 1.08 percent or 82.70 points to 7,760.74.
